arguments.command: npm ci >/dev/null 2>&1; npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo check=$?; git add .github/workflows/release.yml && git commit -q -m "ci: create the draft release and move the major tag when a version tag is pushed" 2>&1 | grep -v Passed; git add CONTRIBUTING.md && git commit -q -m "docs: link to release.yml from CONTRIBUTING.md" 2>&1 | grep -v Passed; git push -q origin HEAD:chore/release-2.3.0 2>&1 | grep -iv "Passed\|Unstaged\|Restored"; git log --oneline -4 origin/chore/release-2.3.0
